pin_kinds.graph_content_sha256: REQUIRED. neurofly-npz-content-v1 fingerprint of outputs/brainlab/flywire_783_female/graph.npz (built locally by python -m brainlab.flywire import). It is also this dataset's graph_sha256 identity in receipts and checkpoints.
pin_kinds.graph_sha256_reference_bytes: Informational: byte sha256 of the reference graph.npz (Linux, numpy 2.x); not required of a local file.
pin_kinds.ids_sha256: Content digest of graph.npz ids as little-endian int64.
pin_kinds.method_sha256: sha256 of brainlab.flywire.METHOD (node universe, edge rule, sign policy, synaptic scale). A different method is a different graph.
pin_kinds.source_sha256: Byte sha256 of the downloaded sources (data-provenance/flywire_783_female/source.lock.json).

licence_note: These are hashes only. The annotation-derived files they describe are local, git-ignored and not redistributed (annotation licence UNKNOWN).
separate_from: brainlab/graph_pins.json (MaleCNS v1.0, the default); never merged
